description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Mentions debts owed to various women, including [...] bt. ʿImrān someone's mother-in-law and Umm ʿAzīz the mother-in-law of Manṣūr b. Furayj (this is for 60 dirahms for a pound of meat). Each is associated with ap articular shabbat. The facing page has remnants of writing in a different very cursive hand.
description_he: כנראה רשימת חייבים ותשלומים. פגום קשות.
